name: Arrows of Acid
body:
When you raise your bow your foes expect to see arrows coming toward them. Their fear turns to pure dread as a volley of acidic missiles hurtle toward them, ready to eat away at their flesh and bone.

Prerequisite(s): 2nd-level arcane archer

Benefit: Instead of firing a normal arrow at an opponent, you may choose instead to fire an acid arrow at an opponent. The acid arrow works as the spell acid arrow, except that the range of the spell is determined by the range of your bow. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your level in arcane archer. This feat cannot be used in conjunction with your hail of arrows ability or the feat Many Shot.
